additional_fields.textual_conclusion: In this paper we have demonstrated the effectiveness of the ResNet architecture against LSTM for Arabic Sign Language recognition. The proposed model achieved higher accuracy while requiring fewer parameters. Its training is significantly faster, and exhibits globally a greater stability

sources.role: Reference [19], the authors' prior LSTM system. Open access CC BY-NC 4.0 PDF at https://www.atlantis-press.com/article/126002698.pdf, accessed 2026-08-28. Supplies the preprocessing, split, and optimizer details the target paper omits but says it inherited, the LSTM architecture behind Table III's comparison column, and the origin of Table III's LSTM accuracy.

Authoritative ArabSign description (also published as doi:10.1109/FG57933.2023.10042720), accessed 2026-08-28. Establishes sample composition, recording modalities, frame statistics, and the absence of an official train/test split.
